item.research_question: Can high-entropy REBCO nanocomposite films be successfully synthesized using chemical solution deposition (CSD) and what are their superconducting properties?
item.processing_route: Chemical solution deposition (CSD) using the TFA-MOD route with optimized growth parameters: Tg = 810 °C and pO2 = 100 ppm
item.test_conditions: Temperature range: 30 K to 77 K, magnetic field range: 0 T to 14 T
key_findings: High-quality Gd0.2Dy0.2Y0.2Ho0.2Er0.2Ba2Cu3O7−δ nanocomposite films with 12 mol% BaHfO3 nanoparticles were successfully synthesized
Tc = 91.9 K and Jsfc = 3.5 MA cm−2 at 77 K
Jc values at 30 K are larger than those of single-RE samples
HEO films show promising performance at high fields and low temperatures
RE distribution is homogeneous in the matrix without forming clusters
item.mechanism: The homogeneous distribution of RE3+ ions in the matrix creates point-like pinning centers, which explain the superior performances of these samples at low temperatures
item.limitations: The Jc values of HEO films are still lower than those of medium-entropy REBCO films, indicating a need for optimization of the composition
item.future_work: Further studies are needed to optimize the composition of HEO films and to investigate the effect of average RE ion size and its variance on the final properties of the films
quotes: the first CSD-grown high-entropy (HE) REBCO nanocomposite films were successfully synthesized
the preparation of this type of films by CSD with excellent quality is possible and demonstrate their potential at low temperatures
the HEO sample might overtake the MEO samples at even higher fields (and or lower temperatures)

records.text: Paper card. Question: Can high-entropy REBCO nanocomposite films be successfully synthesized using chemical solution deposition (CSD) and what are their superconducting properties?. System: Gd0.2Dy0.2Y0.2Ho0.2Er0.2Ba2Cu3O7−δ with 12 mol% BaHfO3 nanoparticles. Processing: Chemical solution deposition (CSD) using the TFA-MOD route with optimized growth parameters: Tg = 810 °C and pO2 = 100 ppm. Test conditions: Temperature range: 30 K to 77 K, magnetic field range: 0 T to 14 T. Findings: High-quality Gd0.2Dy0.2Y0.2Ho0.2Er0.2Ba2Cu3O7−δ nanocomposite films with 12 mol% BaHfO3 nanoparticles were successfully synthesized; Tc = 91.9 K and Jsfc = 3.5 MA cm−2 at 77 K; Jc values at 30 K are larger than those of single-RE samples; HEO films show promising performance at high fields and low temperatures; RE distribution is homogeneous in the matrix without forming clusters. Mechanism: The homogeneous distribution of RE3+ ions in the matrix creates point-like pinning centers, which explain the superior performances of these samples at low temperatures. Limitations: The Jc values of HEO films are still lower than those of medium-entropy REBCO films, indicating a need for optimization of the composition. Future work: Further studies are needed to optimize the composition of HEO films and to investigate the effect of average RE ion size and its variance on the final properties of the films. Quote: "the first CSD-grown high-entropy (HE) REBCO nanocomposite films were successfully synthesized"
